unwired.reason: It reads docs/work/audit-remediation-ledger.md, which is kept out of the repository (git-excluded in the founder's checkout), so in CI it can only fail on a missing file. It is a local tool, not a gate.
unwired.owed: Either commit the ledger it reads or move the script out of scripts/check-*.mjs so it stops reading as a guard.

unwired.reason: It FAILS today: apps/mobile/src/features/shell/capabilityShortcuts.ts decides canUseCamera, canUseCloudModels and canUseVoice from string literals without reading the capability handshake. Wiring a red guard would stop the chain at it.
unwired.owed: Fix the mobile file to read the handshake, then add "pnpm check:capability-boundaries" to check:llm-operability and delete this entry.
